chain_words.nuance: looks over a text to confirm that it is correct
evaluates a text and comments on its strengths and weaknesses
changes parts of a text to improve it
writes a new version of much of the text
changes the structure and content of the text completely

explanation: These words all describe working on a text to improve it, but with increasing extent of change, from a quick check to a complete rebuilding.

usage_notes.difference: 'Revise' means changing parts of a text to improve it, while 'rewrite' means producing a new version of much of the text.
